title: Kamishiro Rui — Unexpected Happenings〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hey, Tsukasa. Are you done there?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah. I lined it up properly with center stage!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thanks! Okay, this gives us the breadth of the stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We've also measured the depth and height.
Now for the number of illuminations.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: If you don't mind, I have a simple stage layout plan here that may help.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Old and malfunctioning lights have been marked with an X.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This...will be very helpful indeed. I do need all the information I can get on the facilities here for our next show, after all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Besides, there's a chance we may find some unused facilities, like the trap room we found during the Halloween show.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you have any other concerns about the stage facilities yourself, Mr. Mascot?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: No, I don't believe there are any issues with the lighting. If I had to mention something, though, it would have to be the audience seats.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Why are you concerned about the audience seats?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line:
They're in quite bad shape.
We did some minor repairs previously, but not every issue has been addressed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right. Some of them are wobbly and not comfortable to sit in. We should really do something about that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's dangerous and needs to be fixed!
Mascot, you have to help us!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Yes, Miss Emu. It may take some time, but I will certainly make the necessary arrangements.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Thank you, Mr. Mascot!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad we have such a competent mascot on board.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, while we're fixing the seats, is it possible for us to tweak them a little as well?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: How do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm thinking of installing a compact device to each seat that allows for theatrical effects using water and wind.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Water and wind effects? How does that work?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe you can think of them as something like 4D effects.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The last time the seats were repaired, I know we were told it's not quite possible to make the seats move...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What about modifying the seats to be able to vibrate, blow gusts of wind, spray water, or emit odors?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If we can achieve that, it would completely differentiate us from the other stages here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ohh! That sounds fabulous!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: What size of device are we talking about here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Small enough to fit under the audience seat. Grand-looking devices won't fit the theme of this stage, anyway, and it's easier to control a device that's simple and compact.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I see... In that case, there's probably no need to notify headquarters about it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You mean, there are cases where we may need to do that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't remember notifying them about the pop-up device we installed for the previous show...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: That's because we settled that for you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. You're really reliable.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Speaking of which, we need to send them a report about the device's state of maintenance and functionality soon.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, is that right? That's perfect, actually.
I'll do the maintenance check right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means...you're up, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, is your safety harness properly attached?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes...but are you really sure this is going to be safe?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've been maintaining it regularly, so I don't think there will be any major safety issues.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Besides, I've added a practice mat like you suggested, so it should be even safer now. In fact, let's go for the highest output setting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Highest output? Why does that sound so cool?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? As usual, I'm having a bad feeling about this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What a coincidence because so am I...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then, Tsukasa. Break through the laws of gravity and become the star you've always wanted to be!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait a minute. You're not seriously going to launch me up that high...are you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Five seconds to liftoff.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: 1. Fire!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: GAAAAH?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooow! Tsukasa's flying so high!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Whoa... That's so height.
This isn't a pop-up device anymore. More like a catapult, if you ask me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Angle and height of flight are just as I've predicted. There's no wind to affect the trajectory either. Mascots, the mat, please.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Already standing by.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Rui, Rui! I wanna go next!
I wanna become a twinkle twinkle little star, too!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: N-No, please! Miss Emu, do not involve yourself with this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aww, why not?! It looks so fun and exciting!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: NAAAAARRRG...bugh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-What in the... This mat is amazing!
I didn't feel any pain at all even after falling from that height!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Instead, when I landed, it almost felt as if I was being enveloped by a gentle embrace!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now I can literally be the brightest star in the sky!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like we even managed to accidentally test out the performance of the new mat as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well now... I've collected plenty of useful data today thanks to everyone's help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think we may even be able to test out a few other things that we've been skipping over so far.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Urgh, as exciting as you're making it sound, why can't I seem to suppress this sense of dread from welling up?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Well, just look forward expectantly to what I have in store.
Hehehe...
